title: Evaluation of Mouse Brain Spatial Cell Type-Resolved Transcriptomics Using 10× Visium
author: Burns, Miramontes, et al.
materials: Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter

steps.title: Gather supplies and set up workstation
steps.instruction: Assemble a liquid‑nitrogen workstation by attaching a Bel‑Art Economy Support Stand, a Three‑Prong Extension, and a metal beaker. Gather Tissue‑Tek Optimal Cutting Temperature (O.C.T.) compound, appropriately sized labeled cryomolds for mouse brain, dry ice or liquid nitrogen, isopentane, a suitable container for the isopentane bath, and forceps. This preparation should be completed about 30 min before perfusion and tissue collection.

steps.title: Pre‑chill isopentane bath
steps.instruction: At least 10 min before freezing tissue, pre‑chill isopentane over a liquid‑nitrogen dewar (or over dry ice if liquid nitrogen is unavailable). Attach the metal beaker to the Three‑Prong Extension, fill it roughly two‑thirds full with isopentane so the tissue can be fully submerged, and hover the beaker about one inch above the liquid‑nitrogen surface. Ensure only a thin frozen layer forms at the bottom of the beaker; if the isopentane freezes completely, remove the beaker from the dewar to allow it to thaw until only the bottom layer remains frozen.

steps.title: Prepare storage box in -80 °C freezer
steps.instruction: Place a pre‑chilled box in a –80 °C freezer; this box will be used to store the frozen tissue samples for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Prepare 4 % PFA fixative
steps.instruction: Make a 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) fixative solution to be used for fixing the right hemisphere of the brain for subsequent immunohistochemistry protein validation.
